subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should this issue close once the focused active-agent plus workspace breadcrumb lands, or should closure require the broader live-target tuple and switch-feedback behavior discussed here?
rationale: Current main clearly lacks persistent workspace header context and the linked PR covers the focused breadcrumb, but the issue discussion broadens the safety contract beyond what automation should silently scope up or down.

options.title: Accept focused breadcrumb
options.body: Land or replace the workspace breadcrumb PR and track session generation, cursor, writable-target, quick-switch, and message-prefix ideas separately.

options.title: Broaden closure bar
options.body: Keep this issue open until the Dashboard proves the fuller live target tuple and switch feedback after reload/reconnect.

options.title: Reject header expansion
options.body: Keep the current active-agent header plus workspace rail workflow as the supported path and close the linked PR by maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Accept focused breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Land or replace the workspace breadcrumb PR and track session generation, cursor, writable-target, quick-switch, and message-prefix ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the current active-agent Dashboard header behavior that the decision would extend or constrain.
